title: Laminated core, package for transformers and inductors used in telecommunication and electronic equipment, Part 1: Dimensions
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 13412 (PART 1)) covers Laminated core, package for transformers and inductors used in telecommunication and electronic equipment, Part 1: Dimensions. This Indian Standard (Fart 2) was adopted by the Magnetic Components and Fertile Materials Sectional Committee had been approved by the Electronics and Telecommunication Division Council. The objective of this Indian Standard is to standardize the electrical characteristics of laminated core packages using YEE-2 laminations for cores made from specified grades of oriented silicon — steel or nickel-iron alloys. This standard (Part 2) is largely based on lEC Pub 1021-2 (1995) "Laminated core packages for transformers and inductors used in telecommunication and electronic equipment : Part 2 Electrical characteristics for cores using YEE-2 laminations', issued by the International Electrotechnical Commission (lEC). This standard (Part 2) is one of the parts of IS 13412 series of standards on laminated core packages. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
